message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker. But Docker is a service; you can start it via Docker Desktop or via Docker Engine. On Windows, you can use Docker Desktop. But the user might want to start the Docker service via command line: `docker start` is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start the Docker Desktop application.
